typography_method.measurement: Computed font sizes on visible meaningful text at default browser scale. Every tested viewport checks CSS zoom 1/normal and no page-wide transform on the document, app shell or workspace.
typography_method.coverage: All four lanes, card Key points and Original text, reader Key points and Original text, editable notes, saved overview and Sources settings. Per-selector comparisons to frozen direction 09 are included in typography[].summary[].selectors.
typography_method.roles: Editable notes are prose; saved source-reading paragraphs are the reader role. Source titles include both cards and reader headers. Hidden icon-only labels and decorative badge numerals are excluded from meaningful text minimums.

visual_review.method: Viewed the new desktop and full-page phone captures, compared with the unchanged Observatory landing and direction 09 captures, and incorporated the independent design review of the populated reader.
observations: The blue-violet heading, ambient canvas, compass mark and rounded white surfaces carry the Observatory style into the sidebar app workspace; there is no hero-page replacement.
Larger card and reader titles, source prose, navigation, controls, factual metadata and chips produce a clear readability gain beyond enlarging the page heading.
The full Research Scout wordmark fits its sidebar and phone drawer; all seven geometry checks pass without hiding document overflow or scaling the page.
The four resource tabs stay in one visual row down to 320px. Toolbars and project actions wrap, and the initial phone view uses fresh navigation with no reader opened automatically.
visual_review.tradeoff: The larger type increases vertical page height and moves the first record lower. The 390px full-page capture should be viewed at native width when comparing text size; a fitted full-page image is reduced by image viewers.
visual_review.qualification: This remains an authored local design preview. Representative contrast and keyboard checks are bounded evidence, not a complete WCAG, screen-reader or production-behavior audit.

limitations: Static authored design preview. Local UI demonstrations do not prove production API, provider/model, persistence or account behavior.
Contrast checks cover representative opaque text/background pairs; gradient/translucent backgrounds are unmeasured and this is not a complete WCAG or screen-reader audit.
Earlier previews are visited read-only for authored-content and typography comparison; their sources, reports and captures are not changed.
